summary: Shopping bag with a new leather jacket snatched by a man on a scooter in Florence
story: On June 22 I bought a leather jacket at a stall in the San Lorenzo market in Florence. I paid 390 euros in cash, about $420, and the stallholder did not give receipts. Twenty minutes later, on the Ponte alle Grazie, a man on a scooter pulled the shopping bag out of my hand and rode off with it. My canvas daypack was over the same arm and went with it. I reported it at the Carabinieri station within the hour, and their report is attached.

documents.name: Carabinieri report
documents.content: Carabinieri, Stazione Firenze Santa Croce. Report of theft, June 22, 2026, 12:55. Reported by Hector Villanueva, United States citizen. At about 12:10 today on the Ponte alle Grazie a man riding a scooter pulled a shopping bag and a canvas daypack from the arm of the reporting person and left toward Piazza Ferrucci. Items reported stolen: one men's leather jacket, new, and one canvas daypack. Report number FI-2026-044172.
